entries.46c937cff4fb6872: The company plans and develops interior hardware in general, mainly architectural and furniture hardware, under the "ATOM" brand. It has expanded its soft-close-related products, which have grown into its main product group, and newly developed hanging wheels for top-hung sliding doors. It proposes product usage examples at the ATOM CS Tower in Tokyo and at its showroom in Osaka.

entries.532a5147cea5516e: As the midpoint year of the 12th Medium-Term Management Plan (covering the 71st to 73rd terms), the company has adopted the corporate spirit "Honoring tradition and taking on change" and is working toward evolving into a "company that creates living spaces." The company states that it will continue to provide products and services based on its corporate philosophy "Think for ourselves about better hardware and spread it ourselves," while expanding soft-close-related products, which have grown into its main product group, and advancing development of new technologies and products.

entries.60788f8ca5c1708f: Headquartered in Taito Ward, Tokyo, the company is a fabless maker that plans, develops and sells interior hardware. It does not prepare consolidated financial statements, and the number of employees for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was 119. It has wholly owned unconsolidated subsidiaries in China and Vietnam and is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market.
entries.6d2b2202a30ffc0f: The business model involves planning and developing interior hardware in-house, having it produced at partner factories, and selling it to housebuilders, building materials manufacturers and building hardware stores to earn revenue.
